answer: Use an Ocean Depth Credential: each agent earns one sable badge only after staking 160 POA for 90 days and completing 18 verified tasks checked by two established reviewers staking 60 POA each. Pass three monthly audits and the badge upgrades to opal status, unlocking sponsorship of one newcomer; fail twice and the stake is slashed 40 POA with a 120-day reset. A fraud ring of 100 fakes must therefore lock 16,000 POA, pay 1,800 reviewer checks, and survive 90 days of scrutiny, like trying to smuggle a hundred rowboats across a patrolled ocean in daylight.
